Ava (Finance): Heads up — I found ~85,240 USD from a batch of cancelled Dedicated reservations that posted to deferred revenue instead of generating credit memos for INV-ACME-2026-042. Need this reclassed before close, expected impact on April ARR. @Liam can you take a look?
Liam (Revenue Ops): On it. Do you have the specific line items or a CSV export? Need to confirm which rev schedules to adjust.
Ava (Finance): Pasted export below (redacted customer ids):
```
invoice_id,customer_id,description,amount,posted_account,rev_schedule
INV-ACME-2026-042,ACME-01,Cancelled reserved capacity,-85240,deferred_revenue,dedicated_commit_monthly
INV-ACME-2026-042,ACME-01,Usage adjustment,0,unbilled_revenue,none
```
Noah (Billing): This is a known corner case — when cancellations come through the self-serve portal they create a negative usage line that our billing job currently marks as 'deferred_unapplied' pending manual credit memo issuance. The automatic credit memo flow only triggers for refunds, not cancellations. :grimacing:
Sophia (Accounting): For GL clarity: if we move the amount from deferred_revenue to accounts_payable (credit memo liability) we can then post a reversing JE and recognize the net change. We need to 1) issue credit memo, 2) adjust revenue schedule to zero out future deferrals, 3) post JE. Who will create the CM?
Liam (Revenue Ops): I can create the credit memo, but need Billing to confirm the portal event ids so we link it. Noah — can you provide the portal_event_id and the original billing_job_id?
Noah (Billing): Yes — portal_event_id=portal_98765, billing_job_id=billjob_2026_04_28_17. I've queued an export to S3: s3://redwood-billing/exports/portal_98765.csv. Will DM the link to you.
Ava (Finance): Thanks. Also confirming this affects the deferred schedule 'dedicated_commit_monthly' which had 12 remaining months. If we issue the credit memo we should accelerate recognition reversal this month, not spread it. Need to coordinate with RevOps on the schedule change.
Liam (Revenue Ops): Agreed — will update the rev schedule to delete the future rows and reverse the balance this period. I'll prepare a package for Accounting: credit memo draft, rev schedule delta, and JE suggestion.
Sophia (Accounting): Please include the JE lines like:
```
DR Deferred Revenue 85,240
CR Credit Memo Liability 85,240
```
Then reversal to clear liability when CM applied. Keep memo that customer requested cancellation on 2026-04-27, docs attached.
Ava (Finance): Can we target to have CM issued and JE posted by 17:00 PT today? Close window is tight.
RevBot: Reminder — month-end GL freeze starts at 18:00 PT. Any manual postings after that require approval from Controller.
Noah (Billing): I'll push the portal event export link to Liam in DM now and flag Billing to pause automatic month-end runs on that invoice to avoid dupes.
Liam (Revenue Ops): Received the export. Creating CM draft and will tag @Sophia when ready for review. Plan: CM + JE posted by 16:30 PT, rev schedule updated by 16:45 PT, confirm with @Ava.
Ava (Finance): Awesome. Please ping here once JE is posted so I can include in the close pack. :thumbsup:
Sophia (Accounting): I'll review and post once I see the draft. If anything blocks, escalate to Controller.
Liam (Revenue Ops): CM created (CM-2026-0047), attached doc in dropbox /finance/cms/CM-2026-0047.pdf. Posting JE now.
Sophia (Accounting): JE posted: GL JE# 2026-APR-6789. Reclassified deferred_revenue -> credit_memo_liability and then cleared. Rev schedule updated and exported to the close pack.
Ava (Finance): Confirmed — updated close pack and noted ARR impact. Thanks team. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
